headline: What will happen to the dollar exchange rate in Ukraine by September 27: banker gives a fresh forecast
summary: A Ukrainian banker gave a fresh forecast for the dollar exchange rate by September 27. He said the biggest autumn risk is costs from new attacks being passed on to final goods prices.
why: The hryvnia's exchange rate against the dollar drives import costs, inflation and central bank policy in Ukraine, a country dependent on external financing.
